module_summary: 8-to-16-bit width converter: a toggle flag tracks byte parity, the first valid byte is held in data_lock and concatenated with the second into data_out with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input byte; first latched, second concatenated into data_out.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input valid toggling flag and enabling latch/output updates.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 16-bit word {data_lock, data_in} registered on second valid byte.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Holds first byte as upper half until second byte arrives.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Byte-parity toggle selecting latch versus output on valid_in.

groups.name: pairing_control
groups.description: Toggle flag tracking first/second byte of each pair.

groups.name: width_packer
groups.description: Latches first byte and concatenates with second into output.
